Appearing on Fox News, Senator Tim Scott urged viewers to visit a fundraising site, warning of extreme Democratic actions if Republicans lose their congressional majorities in the 2026 midterms.

The Poison:
By framing standard legislative competition as an existential, illegal coup, this rhetoric erodes public trust in democratic institutions just to boost short-term campaign coffers.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The Plane Error is WHAT vs WHO. Scott projects a constitutional crisis (WHAT) to obscure the actual beneficiary (WHO): his own party's fundraising apparatus, executing a classic bait-and-switch.

Social Physics Analysis:
Scott runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver. He invents an imminent, extreme threat (impeaching the entire cabinet) as a pretext to justify urgent financial extraction, projecting corrupt, lawless motives onto his political opponents.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated constitutional defense and actual financial extraction, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic strain of manufactured panic yields zero solutions.

The Unavoidable Truth: Impeaching a cabinet requires a supermajority that neither party will possess.
The Unavoidable Lie: Donating to a PAC is the only thing standing between America and total socialism.
